items.difficulty_reason: The lemma transfers boundedness and tor amplitude from K tensor^L O/I to K tensor^L O/I^n uniformly in n (statement lines 12614-12630). Part (1) is an induction on n using the distinguished triangles coming from 0 -> I^n/I^{n+1} -> O/I^{n+1} -> O/I^n -> 0 and the base-change identification of K tensor^L I^n/I^{n+1} as (K tensor^L O/I) tensor^L_{O/I} I^n/I^{n+1}, which is what makes the bound independent of n (proof lines 12637-12660). Part (2) needs an additional reduction, since the test modules in the definition of tor amplitude are O/I^n-modules: one uses the finite filtration of such a module by the powers of I with O/I-module quotients, then rewrites (K tensor^L O/I^n) tensor^L_{O/I^n} G as (K tensor^L O/I) tensor^L_{O/I} G (proof lines 12666-12686). The claim is H2: two explicit reductions, each short once the right triangle and the right filtration are chosen.
